meta.adapter: adapter=NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU (reference GPU; this file's GPU/VRAM ms stay PENDING until the quiesced operator run)
meta.driver: driver=PENDING (recorded on the reference-GPU run; format MAJOR.MINOR, e.g. 537.13)
meta.note: PF13 reference-GPU frame-time baseline. CPU exact pins (ticks/hash/alloc) are machine-independent canonical rows from crates/perf/src/baselines.rs; GPU per-pass ms and VRAM are PENDING until a quiesced release arena run on the reference GPU fills them. Spikes (RT14/VG12/PF15) compare against this file via node tools/perf-baseline.mjs --check.
meta.power_mode: power=High performance (Windows power mode recorded on the reference run)
meta.scene: arena 16-slot canonical (seed 1, 600 ticks, half-extent 20m) plus windowed arena frame capture

quiesce_rule: Quiesce rule: record baselines only with CPU load <10%, 3 quiesced runs within +/-10%, 21 samples with per-sample hash assert; a loaded box is observed-only then, never baseline. A run that fails quiesce keeps status pending/observed-only and must never overwrite a baseline row.
